## Sets & Functions

- **Sets:**
  - [[set-theory-fundamentals]] (operations, algebra, results)
    - [[de-morgans-laws]]
  - [[set-functions]] (images, pre-images; pre-images preserve unions and
    complements, images do not preserve complements)
  - [[limsup-liminf|limsup and liminf of sets]] (see also [[limsup-liminf-and-measure]])
  - [[convex-concave-sets]], [[convex-set]]
- **Relations and cardinality:**
  - [[relations]] (equivalence relations, orderings)
  - [[set-countability]] (cardinality, countability, uncountability of $\mathbb{R}$)
  - Axiom of Choice (used in [[vitalli-non-measurability-theorem]])

## Real Analysis

- **The real line:**
  - [[real-numbers]] (axioms, completeness, order)
  - [[supremum-infimum]]
  - Extended reals $\overline{\mathbb{R}}=[-\infty,\infty]$ (topology, arithmetic conventions)
- **Sequences:**
  - [[sequence-convergence]] (limits, Cauchy sequences, subsequences)
  - [[limsup-liminf|limsup and liminf of sequences]] (inequalities, sums, negatives)
- **Functions on the reals:**
  - [[real-functions]] (limits, continuity, differentiability, integrability)
    - [[continuity-of-real-functions]]
    - [[differentiability]]
  - Semicontinuity: lower and upper semicontinuous functions, semicontinuous
    envelopes
  - [[convergence-of-functions]] (pointwise, uniform)
  - [[images-and-preimages]]
  - [[convex-function]]
- **Riemann integration:**
  - [[riemann-integral]] (upper and lower sums, Lebesgue criterion)
  - Functions which are not Riemann integrable (the Dirichlet function)

## Metric Spaces and Topology

- **Metric spaces:**
  - [[metric-spaces]] (metrics, examples such as $d_\infty$ and $d_1$ on $C([0,1])$)
  - [[cauchy-sequence]], [[completeness]] ($C([0,1])$ is complete under $d_\infty$
    but not under $d_1$)
  - [[epsilon-ball]]
  - [[lipschitz-continuity]]
- **Topology:**
  - [[topology]] (open sets, closed sets, neighborhoods, interior, closure)
  - [[point-set-topologies]] (bases, Hausdorff spaces, continuity,
    homeomorphisms)
  - [[boundary-points]]
  - Structure of open sets in $\mathbb{R}$ (countable unions of open intervals)
- **Compactness:**
  - [[compactness]] (compact sets are closed in Hausdorff spaces, continuous
    bijections from compact spaces are homeomorphisms)
  - Cantor set (closed, nowhere dense, uncountable, measure zero)

## Measure Theory

- **Measurable spaces:**
  - [[measure-spaces|Measure Spaces]]
    - _Algebra, $\sigma$-algebra, monotonicity, finite and countable
      additivity, set generated $\sigma$-algebra._
    - *Measures, properties of measures (continuity from above and below,
      null sets, completeness).*
  - [[generated-sigma-algebra]]
  - [[borel-measure]]
    - _Borel sets, Borel Sigma algebra_
    - *Borel measure*
    - Generators of the Borel $\sigma$-algebra on $\mathbb{R}$ (open, closed,
      half-open intervals and rays)
  - [[product-sigma-algebra]]
  - [[pi-system]], [[monotone-class-theorem]], [[dynkins-pi-lambda-theorem]]
- **Constructing measures:**
  - [[outer-measure|Outer Measures]] (measurable sets, extension of a measure
    to an outer measure)
  - [[caratheodory-extension-theorem|Caratheodory Extension Theorem]]
    - _Extending from pre-measure to full measure._
  - Lebesgue-Stieltjes measures and locally finite Borel measures on
    $\mathbb{R}$ (regularity)
- **Lebesgue measure:**
  - [[exploration-lebesgue-measure]]
  - [[vitalli-non-measurability-theorem]]
    - _Impossible to construct measure without $\sigma$-algebra_
  - Cantor set and Cantor function
  - Lebesgue versus Borel measurable sets (completeness)
- **Measurable functions:**
  - [[measurable-function]]
  - Borel and Lebesgue measurable functions, extended-valued functions
  - Simple functions and approximation by simple functions
  - Almost everywhere equivalence

## Integration

- **The Lebesgue integral:**
  - [[lebesgue-integral]] (simple functions, nonnegative functions,
    $L^1$)
  - Relationship with the Riemann integral ([[riemann-integral]])
- **Convergence theorems:**
  - [[monotone-convergence-theorem]]
  - [[fatou-lemma]]
  - [[dominated-convergence-theorem]]
  - [[uniform-integrability]] (later)
- **Modes of convergence:**
  - Pointwise, uniform and almost everywhere ([[convergence-of-functions]],
    [[convergence-almost-surely]])
  - Convergence in measure (metrizable on finite measure spaces)
    ([[convergence-in-probability]])
  - Egoroff's theorem and Lusin's theorem
- **Inequalities:**
  - [[markov-inequality]], [[chebyshev-inequality]]
  - [[jensen-inequality]]
  - [[holder-inequality]], [[minkowski-inequality]], [[cauchy-schwartz-inequality]]
  - [[triangle-inequality]]
- **Product measures:**
  - Product measures, Tonelli's and Fubini's theorems
  - Counterexamples: completeness of product spaces, non-$\sigma$-finite spaces
- **Differentiation of measures (later):**
  - [[radon-nikodym-derivative]]
  - Signed measures
